documents.vault_subtitle: Every lease, policy, receipt and photo across your portfolio. Add expiry dates to get reminders.

dashboard.first_property_body: Start with a property and its units, then add tenants and leases. Rent will post automatically every month.

properties.main_unit_note: A unit called “Main” is created automatically. For multi-family properties you'll add units next.
properties.welcome: Welcome to Proppros! Start by adding your properties, then tenants and leases.
properties.empty_body: Add each rental property with its address. Units come next.

units.name: Unit name
units.none: No units yet. Add each rentable unit (e.g. “A” and “B” for a duplex).

tenants.email_hint: needed for receipts, reminders and portal
tenants.notes_hint: private — never shown to the tenant
tenants.empty_body: Add your tenants, then create a lease to link them to a unit.
tenants.portal_active: {{name}} can sign in to see their balance and submit requests.
tenants.portal_invited: Invitation sent — waiting for the tenant to accept.
tenants.portal_none: Invite the tenant to view their lease, payments and submit maintenance requests.

leases.empty_body: Create a lease to start posting rent automatically.
leases.recurring_hint: Parking, pet rent, utilities… posted together with rent each month.
leases.in_progress: This lease is already in progress
leases.in_progress_hint: Automatic rent starts from the next due date. Enter what the tenant owes today (if anything) as an opening balance.
leases.auto_rent_from: Rent posts automatically on each due date from {{date}}.
leases.past_start_note: Because the start date is in the past, rent for past due dates will be posted now.
leases.edit_terms_note: Changes apply to future rent postings. Already-posted charges are not changed.
leases.charge_note: Posted with rent starting from the next due date.
leases.end_explainer: No more rent will be posted after this date and the unit will be marked vacant. The ledger stays available so you can settle the final balance and deposit.
leases.delete_confirm: Delete this lease? Only possible when no payments were recorded.

payments.email_receipt_no_email: Email a PDF receipt (tenant has no email)
payments.void_confirm: Void this payment? It will be removed from the ledger.
payments.page_subtitle: Record payments from a lease page. Online payments arrive in a later release.
payments.empty_body: Open a lease and click “Record payment” when rent comes in.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.empty: No entries yet. Rent posts automatically on the due date.

expenses.empty_body: Track repairs, utilities, insurance, taxes and more — with receipt photos.

reports.subtitle: Cash basis: income is payments received; expenses by expense date.
reports.pnl_empty: No income or expenses in this range.

maintenance.empty_body: Tenant requests from the portal show up here, or create one yourself.
maintenance.complete_note: Marks the work order completed and adds the cost to Expenses for this property.

settings.timezone_hint: rent due dates and reminders use this
settings.automation_body: Every day Proppros posts rent and recurring charges, applies late fees after the grace period, and emails rent reminders and lease/document expiry alerts. It runs automatically; you can also run it now. Running it twice never duplicates charges.
settings.run_result: Done — {{charges}} charges posted, {{late}} late fees, {{reminders}} reminders, {{alerts}} alerts sent.
settings.password_hint: 10+ characters with a number or symbol
settings.mfa_on_body: You'll be asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
settings.mfa_off_body: Add a second step to sign-in with an authenticator app like Google Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.
settings.mfa_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
settings.mfa_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
settings.mfa_code_or_recovery: A code from your app, or a recovery code
settings.mfa_prompt_code: Enter a code from your authenticator app to create new recovery codes:
settings.recovery_body: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.
settings.google_linked: Your Google account is linked — you can sign in with Google.

online.title: Online payments
online.not_configured: Online payments aren't set up on this server yet. The administrator needs to add Stripe keys (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET).
online.stripe_intro: Tenants pay by bank transfer (ACH) or card through Stripe. Money goes straight to your own Stripe account and then to your bank — Proppros never holds it.
online.accept_hint: Available once your Stripe account is ready.
online.pass_card_fee: Tenant pays the card processing fee ({{example}})
online.pass_card_fee_note: Bank transfers never carry a fee for tenants. Some states restrict card surcharges — check your local rules before turning this on.
online.returned_fee_hint: charged when a bank payment is returned; 0 = none
online.bank_note: no fee, takes 4–5 business days to clear
online.pending_note: {{amount}} from an earlier payment is still processing and is already deducted.
online.secure_note: You'll finish on Stripe's secure checkout page. Proppros never sees your bank or card details.
online.blocked_note: Online payments are turned off for this lease. Please contact your landlord.
online.autopay_off_confirm: Turn off autopay? You'll need to pay each month yourself.
online.autopay_status: Autopay is on — your balance is charged to {{method}} on each due date.
online.processing_note: {{amount}} is processing and will show in your statement once it clears.
online.payment_success: Thanks! Your payment was submitted. Card payments show right away; bank transfers appear once they clear.
online.autopay_enabled: Autopay is being set up. It'll show here in a moment.
online.block_label: Block online payments for this lease
online.block_hint: e.g. after serving an eviction notice; tenants can't pay online and autopay pauses.

billing.not_active: Paid plans aren't switched on yet. Everything works on the current plan — there's nothing to pay.
billing.checkout_success: Thanks! Your subscription is active. It can take a few seconds to show here.

marketing.lead: Leases, rent, maintenance and reports for independent landlords — in one calm, organized place your tenants can use too.
marketing.free_note: Free for up to 3 units. No card needed.
marketing.feature_leases_body: Every term, date and document in one place, with reminders before renewals and move-outs.
marketing.feature_rent_body: Charges post automatically each month. Record payments in seconds and see who's behind at a glance.
marketing.feature_maintenance_body: Tenants report issues with photos; you assign, track costs and keep everyone updated.
marketing.feature_reports_body: Profit and loss, rent roll and expenses by property, ready to export at tax time.
marketing.feature_portal_body: Tenants see their lease, balance and documents, and send requests — no app to install.
marketing.feature_team_body: Invite a manager, accountant or handyman and limit them to the properties they look after.
marketing.pricing_title: Simple pricing that grows with you
marketing.pricing_lead: Start free. Pay per unit only when your portfolio grows.
marketing.pricing_note: Prices in USD per unit per month. Cancel any time.

onboarding.title: Let's set up your portfolio
onboarding.portfolio_intro: Give your portfolio a name and confirm your time zone — it's used for due dates and reminders.
onboarding.lease_intro: Add the current lease for {{unit}}. You can add more leases later.
onboarding.done_body: Your portfolio is ready. Here are some good next steps.
onboarding.done_with_lease: Your lease is in. Rent charges will post automatically each month.
onboarding.next_tenants: Invite your tenants to the portal

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Proppros-wide view of organizations, users and feedback.
admin.billing_on: Billing is on: plan limits are enforced and paid plans can be purchased.
admin.billing_off: Billing is off: plan limits are not enforced. Set BILLING_ENABLED and the Stripe price IDs to turn it on.
admin.search_users: Search users by name or email
admin.impersonate_note: Signing in as a user starts a 60-minute support session. It is recorded in that organization's audit log.
admin.impersonate_confirm: Sign in as {{email}}? This is recorded in their audit log.
admin.impersonating: You're signed in as {{name}} ({{email}}) for support.

signing.no_templates: You don't have a lease template yet.
signing.create_template: Create one from the starter template
signing.no_email_note: Some tenants have no email address. You'll get a signing link to share with them yourself.
signing.links_body: Each tenant gets their own link. If email isn't set up, copy a link and send it by text or WhatsApp. Links work once and expire in 30 days.
signing.empty_body: Fill a lease template with this lease's details and collect signatures online — no printing or scanning.
signing.void_confirm: Void this document? Its signing links stop working.
signing.voided: This document was voided by the landlord and can no longer be signed.
signing.all_done: Everyone has signed. A copy has been emailed to all parties.
signing.you_signed: Thanks — you've signed. You'll get a copy once everyone has signed.
signing.consent: I have read this document and agree to sign it electronically. My electronic signature is as valid as a handwritten one.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Write your lease once and reuse it. Merge fields like {{example}} are filled in from each lease when you send it for signature.
templates.empty_body: Start from our general residential lease and adapt it to your state's rules.
templates.format_hint: Formatting: # Heading, ## Section, - bullet, **bold**, *italic*, --- for a line.
templates.fields_hint: Click a field to insert it at the cursor.
templates.delete_confirm: Delete the template “{{name}}”? Documents already sent keep their text.

renewal.message_hint: Optional — e.g. why the rent is changing
renewal.offer_note: Tenants are emailed and can accept or decline in their portal. If they answer in person, record it here. Accepting creates the new lease automatically.
renewal.empty_body: This lease ends {{date}}. Offer a renewal a couple of months before.
renewal.empty_body_mtm: This lease is month-to-month. You can offer a new fixed-term lease any time.
renewal.accept_confirm: Record that the tenants accepted? A new lease will be created.
renewal.portal_accepted: You accepted this renewal. Your landlord may send the new lease for signature.

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.empty: Record the unit's condition room by room, with photos, at move-in and move-out.
inspections.no_baseline: There's no move-in inspection for this lease, so there's nothing to compare against.
inspections.delete_confirm: Delete this draft inspection and its photos?
inspections.complete_body: {{checked}} of {{total}} items are checked. Completing locks the checklist and creates a PDF report saved to the lease's documents.
inspections.share: Share the report with the tenants in their portal

deposit.title: Security deposit statement
deposit.intro: Itemize any deductions and send the statement to your tenants. Check your state's deadline for returning deposits.
deposit.unpaid_balance_hint: Posted to the lease ledger as a credit when you send
deposit.owed: Tenants still owe {{amount}} after the deposit
deposit.send_confirm: Send the statement to the tenants? It can't be changed afterwards.
